title: The spec introduces three operator-visible per-category outcomes—produced findings, produced none, and not det
text: The spec introduces three operator-visible per-category outcomes—produced findings, produced none, and not determined—but the Statuses / Enum Values section defines neither stable code values nor display labels for them. Because these outcomes are emitted in check-run, log, and benchmark evidence, implementation would have to invent the output contract. Add the enum definitions and state that lifecycle transitions are not applicable if these are terminal per-pass results.
rationale: Real defect: the flagged lines changed in 683cd13, the next commit. Ronda v0.2.0 posted no matching finding on this head.
